notes: Current Chablis grand cru specification homologated by arrêté of 24 October 2024 and in force from 10 November 2024. The 2011 decree is abrogated. The conditional fermentable-sugar allowance to 4 g/L at sufficient total acidity is conservatively fail-closed at the unconditional 3 g/L ceiling until that conditional analytical rule is represented.

chablis_grand_cru_masaa_2024.authority: Ministère de l'agriculture, de la souveraineté alimentaire et de la forêt
chablis_grand_cru_masaa_2024.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOC Chablis grand cru homologué par l'arrêté du 24 octobre 2024
chablis_grand_cru_masaa_2024.scope: Current specification: white still wine exclusively Chardonnay; seven official climat names; 178 g/L minimum must sugar; 11% minimum natural alcohol; 54 hL/ha normal yield; 64 hL/ha rendement butoir; <=3 g/L unconditional fermentable sugar; <=13.5% total alcohol after enrichment; elevage through 15 March N+1; consumer release from 31 March N+1; wood pieces and continuous presses prohibited.

chablis_grand_cru_legifrance_2024.authority: Journal officiel de la République française / Légifrance
chablis_grand_cru_legifrance_2024.title: Arrêté du 24 octobre 2024 homologuant le cahier des charges de l'AOC Chablis grand cru
chablis_grand_cru_legifrance_2024.scope: Homologates the current specification and abrogates decree n°2011-1583.

specs.notes: Current law from 10 November 2024. The normal positive path is 100% Chardonnay. The source also sets a 64 hL/ha rendement butoir and prohibits wood pieces and continuous presses; the ordinary 54 hL/ha yield is enforced here, while butoir and equipment prohibitions remain source metadata until dedicated mechanics are added.
